app.title: SWAT Wetlands
wetlands_tab.title: Wetland Parameters (.pnd)
wetlands_tab.instructions: Each column below is a subbasin and each row a wetland parameter (.pnd). Click a subbasin's header -- or select it above and use "Edit in .pnd" -- to open its full editor. Double-click a cell to edit a single value. "Load CSV" stages bulk changes without writing them yet; "Materialize to SWAT" writes staged changes to the real .pnd files.
hru_tab.title: HRU Parameters (.hru)
hru_tab.instructions: This table shows every HRU of the subbasin selected above (rows) and each recognized parameter (columns). Double-click an HRU's id -- or select it above and use "Edit in .hru" -- to open its full editor. Double-click any other cell to edit a single value. "Export CSV" downloads a template for the visible subbasin; "Load CSV" stages bulk changes without writing them yet; "Materialize to SWAT" writes staged changes to the real .hru files.

nbs_tab.title: NbS (Nature-based Solutions)
nbs_tab.subtitle: Build a reusable land-cover change (an NbS) once, then apply it to any subbasin/HRU. Creating an NbS never touches TxtInOut; applying it writes directly on the open project's real .hru/.mgt/plant.dat files.
nbs_tab.confirm_delete: Delete the NbS "{name}"? This only removes it from the library; it does not undo anything already applied to HRUs.
nbs_tab.no_targets_error: Add at least one target HRU before applying.
nbs_tab.no_nbs_selected_error: Select an NbS from the library first.
nbs_tab.confirm_apply: Apply "{name}" to {count} HRU(s)? This writes directly on the open project's real .hru/.mgt files (and plant.dat if it creates a new coverage) and cannot be undone automatically.
nbs_tab.apply_summary: Applied to {applied}/{total} HRU (plant_id={plant_id}, cpnm={cpnm}). See log below for details.
nbs_tab.area_apply_subtitle: Give a total area (ha) to convert in a subbasin and split it across the source coverages it should come from (e.g. 40% from forest, 60% from pasture). Whole HRUs of each source coverage are selected, by slope/soil priority, until that area is covered.

nbs_tab.area_preview_deficit_line: deficit: {deficit:.2f} ha not covered (not enough source HRU available).
nbs_tab.area_preview_no_source_line: no HRU with this coverage available in this subbasin; skipped.
